Azúcar's got a secret and it's dying to get out 🔥🎱 Saturday, Azúcar debuts something we've NEVER done before — Sappholicious, our very own burlesque troop, hosted by La Bon. This ain't a rumor, mama, this is happening. Sultry choreo, straight-up pool table tricks, comedy sharp enough to leave your jaw on the floor. Who's performing? Cero pistas — you gotta show up to find out. All-inclusive cast, unrefined energy, and a debut that only happens once like this. Esto no se repite, so if you're waiting for the 'next one,' there isn't one — this IS the one. Get your people together, dress bold, and be in that room when the lights go down. You'll want to say you were there from night one. Sapphic Sugar Cabaret is coming for Pasco and it's not holding back 💋

📅 Saturday, August 22 • 9PM • Main Floor
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $15-$35
